axes.normalization: shared F64 orthonormal axes; radius=max measured interval norms
axes.construction: F64 ordered Gram-Schmidt; no rescaling by case or loss, no rank cutoff

reconstruction: original-native-rebased F32 Torch products and existing FP16-cache estimator; fixed histories and computational pairs
prediction_vs_result: Every reported vertex is a finite evaluation. Compare loss and raw discrepancy jointly with realized BF16 motion; no automatic crater verdict.
failures_only: Self-reference forces its own center agreement; the nonself fitting success helped calibrate tolerance and is near the target. One plane and coarse grid cannot establish general sharpness or stability.
what_this_changes: Provides measured fitting-only computational surfaces for inspection, without changing the learner, objective, reference or tolerance.
